title: Need some honest feedback and advice on 2D graphics
author: Zealousideal_Bit5524
selftext:
Ok so I keep getting the usual ai slop and negativity from reddit on my game wich is on google play store and actually doing well for an indie. But most the hate i get on here is for the graphics, and im confused because im looking at other 2D autobattlers out there even big bame ones and the graphics are not really any better, some are much worse. Then I see games on here that are just picture based games getting praised and I get "that looks like shit" lol. What am I missing? Are these just typical reddit trolls dragging me down or is there something someone can show me as an example of a good 2D rpg style game that will enlighten me to all the hate? Thanks for any advice in advance, here's the full game if anyone wants to see more more of the graphics, I cant post long videos on here for some reason.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wnapp.id1789641432616

comments.author: TheMightyOscar
comments.body: The gameplay looks like the games where they show you fake gameplay and once you download the game you play a totallly different game, like a city management kind of game

replies.author: Zealousideal_Bit5524
replies.body: This is an exact video from the game, not edited or even boosted with HD or anything. Raid shadow legends does that though, have these epic trailers and the gameplay looks nothing like that lol

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: You character style shifts. No true animation with the sprites. You bgs are massive making your characters super small. The shadows and rings are off centered.  You UI looks like just generic ai. Also all your sprites look like generic ai. You got to push AI out of tits normal rhythm of gen making.

replies.author: Zealousideal_Bit5524
replies.body: Can you show me an example please of a 2d game that gets it right? So I can have a comparison? And the BG is massive to give the affect of them being in an arena, its a gladiator style game. If the players were bigger than the door or walls for instance would be weird, but i do see what you are talking about

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body:
It's getting roasted because there are glaring issues. For instance, your google play store screenshot's UI is bugged. You have the "?" overlapping the "Replace" button. This just screams slop. You didn't even take the time to fix the UI before shipping the game, let alone the screenshot. 

Another obvious example is literally your first store screenshot, the top right corners says "CURRENT: SIG....." and it's cut off. I use ai too. But cmon dude, at least fix your UI that's going on the store pages 😂 .

The video you posted the characters and background look very ai generated.   
  
I don't think there's anything wrong with AI use but it just looks like a collection of poorly assembled prompts. It feels rushed and sloppy. I haven't played the game so maybe people are really enjoying it and don't mind the artwork. But that's why redditors are giving you shit. 

Especially in any gamedev subs, where people are actually building stuff themselves and spending 10x as long building games. They aren't big fans of people doing nothing by hand, especially those who do not know basic UI design principles.

https://i.redd.it/pqibh71luh0i1.png

comments.author: Extempes
comments.body:
Tbh the First thing I notice is your visuals dont Match with each Other and seem Like assets from multiple different games. 
- Another thing is the characters seem like they arent really in the Arena.

Some minor issues I see:
- dmg Feedback seems lacking, Just some wibbly wobbly( might be Intendet but would bother melden playing it)
- dmg numberes Look Out of place


In the First Look that all from me, but I am not a expert or anything hopefully my Feedback is still  of use and not too harsh ✌🏻

replies.author: Zealousideal_Bit5524
replies.body: Thank you i absolutely appreciate the feedback and will work on these

comments.author: Zealousideal_Bit5524
comments.body: Ive fixed alot of the ui stuff including what you mentioned but the new screenshots havnt updated with g play yet for some reason. You are right though great advice, except i did spend a ton of time on this. My game has very unique feature that is impossible without ai or a huge team. Every summoned hero/gladiator is unique to only you, so every player has a unique team to display to other players. The heros are removed once chosen and new ones generated. This could not be kept up with without ai. Noone can design sprites all day, ai can.
